{{Quotation|game|Though it appears to be just another of [[Kaineng City]]'s numerous slum districts, the Nahpui Quarter is actually home to the Adepts who serve [[Suun]], the mysterious Oracle of [[the Mists]]. Within these "slums" they study the words and teachings of the Oracle while protecting the downtrodden in secret. If you wish to become [[Weh no Su|Closer to the Stars]], this is the place to begin.}}

[[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]] is one of the many slum districts that make up the majority of Kaineng City, housing its share of Kaineng's poor and underprivileged citizens.

==Getting there==
This outpost is located at the southern end of [[Wajjun Bazaar]] and is easily reached, but characters are denied entry until they acquire and complete the [[primary quest]] [[Closer to the Stars]].
